title: Mars Has the Solar System's Largest Volcano
post_title: Mars Has the Solar System's Largest Volcano | QuantaTale
post_description: The biggest volcano we know in the solar system is on Mars—and it dwarfs Everest. Discover the science behind it. Sources: https://science.nasa.gov/mars/facts/ https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/press_kits/insight/landing/facts/mars-at-a-glance/ #Science #ScienceFacts #Education #QuantaTale
narration: Mars is home to Olympus Mons, the largest volcano in the solar system. NASA describes it as more than 25 miles, or about 40 kilometres, from base to summit. Its base covers an area comparable to the state of Arizona. It is a giant shield volcano built by repeated flows of lava over immense periods of time. Mars has no active plate tectonic system like Earth's, which helps explain how such enormous volcanic structures could grow in one region.
